import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from fuzz import gen_trace, run_impl, entry
import ref

STATUS = {"dropped", "accepted", "duplicate", "error", "buffered"}
REASONS = {"OK", "AUTH", "DUPLICATE", "KEYS_DISCARDED", "BUFFER_FULL",
           "EARLY_REJECTED", "INITIAL_TOO_SMALL", "LAYOUT", "NO_KEYS",
           "CONNECTION_CLOSED", "FRAME_ENCODING_ERROR", "PROTOCOL_VIOLATION",
           "FINAL_SIZE_ERROR", "FLOW_CONTROL_ERROR", "STREAM_STATE_ERROR",
           "STREAM_LIMIT_ERROR", "CRYPTO_BUFFER_EXCEEDED", "IDLE_TIMEOUT",
           "PEER_APPLICATION_CLOSE", "PEER_TRANSPORT_CLOSE"}
KEYSTATE = {"absent", "live", "discarded"}

def check_shape(res, tr):
    assert set(res) == {"id", "packets", "connection", "keys", "received_total",
                        "streams", "crypto"}, set(res)
    npk = sum(len(ev.get("packets", [])) for ev in tr["events"] if ev["op"] == "datagram")
    assert len(res["packets"]) == npk, (len(res["packets"]), npk)
    seen = set()
    prev = None
    for p in res["packets"]:
        assert set(p) == {"event", "packet", "status", "reason", "at_ms", "frame"}, set(p)
        assert p["status"] in STATUS
        assert p["reason"] in REASONS
        assert p["status"] != "dropped" or p["frame"] is None
        assert isinstance(p["at_ms"], int) and 0 <= p["at_ms"] <= 10 ** 12
        ev = tr["events"][p["event"]]
        assert 0 <= p["packet"] < len(ev["packets"])
        key = (p["event"], p["packet"])
        assert key not in seen
        seen.add(key)
        if prev is not None:
            assert prev < key, (prev, key)
        prev = key
    c = res["connection"]
    assert set(c) == {"state", "code", "at_ms", "source", "peer_code",
                      "last_activity_ms"}, set(c)
    assert c["state"] in ("open", "closed", "idle")
    if c["state"] == "open":
        assert c["code"] is None and c["at_ms"] is None and c["source"] is None \
            and c["peer_code"] is None
    else:
        assert c["code"] in REASONS and isinstance(c["at_ms"], int)
        s = c["source"]
        assert set(s) == {"event", "packet", "frame"}
        assert c["code"].startswith("PEER_") == (c["peer_code"] is not None)
    assert set(res["keys"]) == {"I", "H", "Z", "A"}
    for v in res["keys"].values():
        assert v in KEYSTATE
    assert isinstance(res["received_total"], int) and res["received_total"] >= 0
    ids = [s["id"] for s in res["streams"]]
    assert ids == sorted(ids)
    for s in res["streams"]:
        assert set(s) == {"id", "highest", "final_size", "reset", "stopped",
                          "delivered_hex"}
        assert type(s["reset"]) is bool and type(s["stopped"]) is bool
        assert all(ch in "0123456789abcdef" for ch in s["delivered_hex"])
        assert len(s["delivered_hex"]) % 2 == 0
    assert [x["level"] for x in res["crypto"]] == ["I", "H", "A"]
    for x in res["crypto"]:
        assert set(x) == {"level", "highest", "contiguous_hex"}
        assert len(x["contiguous_hex"]) % 2 == 0
    # received_total consistency
    assert res["received_total"] == sum(s["highest"] for s in res["streams"])

def main(n=1200, seed=11):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    for it in range(n):
        traces = [gen_trace(rng, "t%d" % i, rng.randint(1, 30))
                  for i in range(rng.randint(1, 3))]
        doc = {"version": 1, "traces": traces}
        got = run_impl(doc)
        exp = [ref.replay(t) for t in traces]
        for res, tr in zip(got, traces):
            check_shape(res, tr)
        if got != exp:
            print("MISMATCH", it)
            print(json.dumps(doc))
            return 1
    print("invariants+fuzz ok (%d docs)" % n)
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(int(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else 1200,
                  int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 11))
EOF
